about: Every main GTA hero (Delta, pillar 3 GTA history, 'Every X' catalog). Scope: the main console GTA games since GTA III (2001): III, Vice City, San Andreas, IV, V, VI (spin-offs, handhelds, episodes, GTA 1/2/London left out; scope chip on screen). Claude is unnamed and silent in GTA III; the name came officially with San Andreas (2004) per Wikipedia. Tommy Vercetti and Carl 'CJ' Johnson: Rockstar Store (Trilogy page). Niko Bellic, Liberty City: rockstargames.com/games/IV. Michael, Franklin, Trevor: Rockstar's own post 'Grand Theft Auto V Trailers: Michael. Franklin. Trevor.' (PlayStation Blog, R*Q, Apr 30 2013); Los Santos: Rockstar Store GTA V page. GTA VI: rockstargames.com/VI 'Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia...', 'the state of Leonida', 'Jason and Lucia's story', 'Grand Theft Auto VI: Out Now · November 19, 2026'. 24 years = Vice City Oct 29 2002 to GTA VI Nov 19 2026 (our math, 24.06 y). First release years per Wikipedia/Take-Two. Sources in BRIEF.md.
